Kent County, DE Probate Adm. Bond - May 5, 1815 Rec'd Book D 227 Book P-73

excerpt: Hugh Durham, Angelica Lockerman and Susan Durham all of Kent Co., DE posted a bond of two hundred dollars naming Hugh Durham as the administrator on the estate of Rachel Handser, deceased. All three signed the bond with their marks.

excerpt: Hugh Durham, Angelica Lockerman and Susan Durham all of Kent Co., DE posted a bond of two hundred dollars naming Hugh Durham as the administrator on the estate of Rachel Handser, deceased. All three signed the bond with their marks.

loose piece of paper: I Susan Durham, oldest daughter of Rachel Handser, dec'd do hereby renounce all my right and claim of Administrating on the estate of my said dec'd mother, Rachel Handsor and my wish and desire is that Letters of Admin. on her Estate may be granted to Hugh Durham, witness my hand this 5 May, 1815. Susan Durham (signed with her mark)
